# Fix round 5 — WP 20 (`claude/impl-8397-a1-landing`, head `bfe4a1135d99318987fa4a98260610cb44e69db2`, PR #8626): CI pytest red

PR #8626 CI `pytest (1)` fails:
```text
FAILED tests/build/test_lesson_assembler.py::test_canonical_site_routes_and_frontmatter_groups
subprocess.CalledProcessError: node -e … fs.readFileSync('site/src/lib/a1-lesson-nav.ts') …
```
Root cause: this test transpiles pieces of `site/src/pages/[...slug].astro` together with `site/src/lib/a1-archive-routes.ts`, `site/src/lib/a1-lesson-nav.ts` and `site/src/data/a1-v1-modules.ts` to evaluate `getStaticPaths()`. WP 20 deleted `a1-lesson-nav.ts` and moved `resolveNavHref` to `site/src/lib/doc-nav.ts`, and the router now also imports the arc code. This file was not in the earlier acceptance runs.

Fix the test so it evaluates the router as it now is: read `site/src/lib/doc-nav.ts` instead of the deleted file, and add whatever else the selected router statements now reference (read `[...slug].astro`'s imports; `A1_UNITS` may no longer exist — adjust the `wanted` set to the names that exist). Keep what the test proves: the canonical site routes and the frontmatter groups, now including the generated `/a1/` landing and module routes. Update its expected routes if WP 20 intentionally changed them, and say which.

Then run the **whole** Python suite once, to catch any other sibling (`git grep -n a1-lesson-nav` shows only this test and a guard in `tests/test_landings_use_levellanding.py` that asserts the name is absent — keep that guard).

## Acceptance
```bash
/home/ops/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/build/test_lesson_assembler.py tests/test_landings_use_levellanding.py tests/build/test_build_arc_landing.py
/home/ops/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -n 8 tests
/home/ops/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/ruff check scripts tests
```
